candidates.change_summary: Change the position expiration assignment key from `order.isLong ? uint256(orderHash) : positionId` to always use `positionId`, so long and short positions share the same expiration key.
Change the position expiration value from `block.timestamp + order.duration` to `block.timestamp`, so filled positions expire immediately.
Change the duration bound check from `< 10_000 days` to `< 20_000 days`, allowing longer durations and thus different expiration timestamps.
Change the expiration deadline check from `block.timestamp < order.expiration` to `block.timestamp <= order.expiration`, allowing orders exactly at expiration to be filled.
Delete the `require(order.baseAsset.code.length > 0, "baseAsset is not contract")` check, allowing fills with non-contract base assets.
Move the external ERC20 transfer call before the unclaimedFees[asset] state reset, so a re-entrant callee can observe/act on the fee balance while the external call is in progress.
Replace the fee-reset assignment with a no-op self-assignment, leaving the unclaimedFees entry unchanged after withdrawFees completes.
Emit WithdrewFees with the recipient address in place of the asset key, altering the emitted fee-withdraw event while leaving the state reset intact.
Delete the ERC20 fee transfer call so withdrawFees only zeroes the recorded fee without paying it out.
Weaken the onlyOwner guard to always pass, allowing any caller to invoke privileged fee/state-changing functions such as withdrawFees.
